answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Guaranteed abattoir licence with food standards attestation. It demands a licence standards officers renew after hygiene audits, and the glacier is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the crystal compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the cipher for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
